epic: Add a '## Runtime verification' section to plan.md and execute it as a build-verify gate

stories.title: Add a '## Runtime verification' section to plan.md and execute it as a build-ver
stories.description: Let the plan author declare one critical-path verification command (e.g. curl .../health, a CLI smoke invocation); build-verify reads and runs it as a named gate. An author-driven alternative to A1's auto-detection.
